# 基因变异次数统计

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

## 读取数据

```{r}
PATH <- "/Users/peiyuliu/Desktop/PKU-Undergraduate-Course-Public/生物信息学实验(Bioinformatics Lab.)/Week6/results/3 GeneAnnotation/step4.variant_function"
```

```{r}
variations <- read.table(PATH, sep='\t')
variations
```

## 数据清洗

### 去除\`intergenic\`的变异

```{r}
variations <- subset(variations, V1!='intergenic')
rownames(variations) <- NULL
variations
```

### 去除基因名称列中的括号并分割多个基因

```{r}
variations$V2 <- gsub("\\(.*?\\)", "", variations$V2)
variations2 <- separate_rows(as_tibble(variations), V2, sep = ',')
variations2

```

##  统计每个基因变异次数并绘图

```{r}
freq <- as.data.frame(table(variations2$V2))
freq <- sort_by(freq, freq$Freq, decreasing=TRUE)
rownames(freq) <- NULL
freq
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = freq, mapping = aes(x = Freq)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, color = "black") + labs(x = "mutation times", y = "gene counts")
ggsave("histogram.pdf")
```
